texts.name: Frederick
texts.biography: Frederick had been living a life of an ordinary Bracadan mage and alchemist, even if a bit more inquiring than his fellows. Curiosity first brought him to experimenting with mechanisms, and eventually lured him into doing forbidden research. In the end, Frederick had to flee from Bracada, and now he searches for a better place to devote himself to what he wants.

specialty.name: Automatons
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Automatons and Sentinel Automatons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
